characters.name: PEETER
characters.description: Väike inimene, umbes 5-aastane poiss kollase kapuutsiga kampsuni, sinise pehme mütsi ja tumepruunide lühikeste pükstega, tumepruunid lühikesed juuksed, lõbus naeratus ja suured pruunid silmad. Armas multifilmistiil.

characters.name: LIISA
characters.description: Väike inimene, umbes 6-aastane tüdruk kollase kampsuni ja punaste traksipükstega, heledad patsid, rõõmus soe ilme ja uudishimulikud sinised silmad. Armas multifilmistiil.

locations.name: Kodune köök
locations.description: Cozy autumn kitchen with yellow painted walls, light wooden floor, single window on the back wall showing colorful autumn trees with falling orange leaves outside. In the center is a sturdy light wooden table with wooden chairs. On the right side of the room is a simple stove with a large metal cooking pot. Sunny warm atmosphere, bright and clean cartoon style.

pages.scene: Peeter, a 5-year-old boy in a yellow hooded sweater and blue beret, and Liisa, a 6-year-old girl with blonde braids in a yellow sweater and red overalls, stand in the middle of a cozy kitchen. Sunlight streams through the kitchen window which shows autumn trees outside. The kitchen has yellow walls and a wooden floor.

Peeter and Liisa stand by the wooden table in the cozy yellow kitchen, pointing playfully to their tummies and smiling. An empty bowl sits on the wooden table. Outside the window, autumn leaves are falling.

Liisa, wearing her yellow sweater, places several bright orange carrots onto the wooden table in the cozy kitchen. Peeter stands beside her, watching with joy. The kitchen walls are yellow with a window showing autumn trees.
Peeter stands by a small water sink in the kitchen, washing a small round orange pumpkin with water. Liisa stands next to him, watching happily. The room has yellow walls and wooden floors.
Peeter carefully puts the small clean pumpkin into a large metal pot resting on the stove. Liisa stands beside him watching attentively. Warm cozy kitchen with yellow walls.
Liisa holds a wooden spoon and gently stirs the soup inside the large metal pot on the warm stove. Gentle steam rises from the pot. Peeter stands next to her, looking happy.
Peeter and Liisa lean closer to the cooking pot on the stove, sniffing the delicious warm steam rising from the soup with big happy smiles. Sunlight fills the warm kitchen.
Peeter and Liisa sit at the wooden table in the cozy kitchen, eating delicious warm soup from ceramic bowls with spoons. They have satisfied, happy expressions.
